boundaryPacket.requiredApprovals: Operator says yes to an agent pushing the go-live branch and opening the pull request; the first tests and images runs happen on that pull request and on main after the merge; Operator merges the Sellbird go-live pull request (after CI is green); Operator merges or approves the platform overlay change that points at the new base, and creates the provider secrets through the platform's secret path; Operator trains the hosted Sellbird (the `sellbird train` command, run by kubectl exec against the product's website) and confirms the Claude login works; Operator approves one pod delete for SCN-LIVE-002 and the three workflow_dispatch control runs (failing-test, none, vulnerable-image); Sending stays paused on the live Sellbird for the whole boundary run; the approved-send control runs on the local stand-in with a test transport
stopConditions: any FAIL stops the run and goes to B5 repair
a redaction match in the evidence folder stops the run
a live scenario whose operator prerequisite is missing is recorded BLOCKED and the run stops

budgets.exhaustion: checkpoint and BLOCKED; never a silent PASS; documentation and state may be saved without running product tests

releaseClaim.userOperation: The operator signs in to the hosted dashboard and finds Sellbird running its outreach loop in the cluster, with training and settings that survive restarts and every email waiting for approval.
